title: Japanese Kabanos-Style Okonomiyaki
description: A fusion of Japanese okonomiyaki and Hungarian kabanos sausage, this dish combines the savory flavors of the two cuisines.
instructions: Preheat a skillet or griddle over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced kabanos sausage and cook until browned and crispy, about 5 minutes.
Add the sliced shiitake mushrooms and cook until tender, about 3 minutes.
Add the thinly sliced cabbage, zesty cabbage, and pungent garlic. Cook until the cabbage is slightly wilted, about 2 minutes.
In a small bowl, whisk together the okonomiyaki sauce and Japanese mayonnaise. Brush the sauce mixture over the top of the sausage and vegetables.
Transfer the skillet to the oven and bake at 400°F (200°C) for 5-7 minutes, or until the sauce is caramelized and bubbly.
Remove from the oven and sprinkle with Panko breadcrumbs, if using.
Slice into wedges and serve hot.
